gloss: severing of relations; breaking off ties

definitions.gloss: severing of diplomatic relations; breaking off ties
definitions.explanation: The formal termination of diplomatic or other official relations between countries. Can also be used more broadly for cutting off personal relationships.

examples.japanese: ⟦{両国|りょうこく}→両国：10010_ryoukoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{断交|だんこう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The two countries severed diplomatic relations.

examples.japanese: {断交|だんこう}⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{何年|なんねん}→何年：12737_nannen⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: The state of severed relations has continued for many years.

examples.japanese: ⟦{紛争|ふんそう}→紛争：05758_funsou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦きっかけ→きっかけ：10309_kikkake⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{断交|だんこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{至|いた}った→至る：02009_itaru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦その{後|ご}→その後：08501_sonogo⟧{和平|わへい}⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{回復|かいふく}した→回復する：21330_kaifukusuru⟧。
examples.english: The conflict led to a severing of relations, but afterward ties were restored through peace negotiations.

notes:
Compound of {断|だん} (cut, sever) and {交|こう} (relations, association). Primarily used in diplomatic and international relations contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {断交|だんこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to sever relations
- {断交|だんこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{至|いた}る→至る：02009_itaru⟧: to reach the point of severing relations
- {断交|だんこう}⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧: state of severed relations
- ⟦{国交|こっこう}{断絶|だんぜつ}→国交断絶：23264_kokkoudanzetsu⟧: complete severance of diplomatic relations

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{国交|こっこう}{断絶|だんぜつ}→国交断絶：23264_kokkoudanzetsu⟧: severance of diplomatic relations — more formal and emphatic
- ⟦{絶交|ぜっこう}→絶交：15544_zekkou⟧: breaking off a friendship — used for personal relationships
- ⟦{断行|だんこう}→断行：15618_dankou⟧: decisive action — homophone with different meaning (to carry out resolutely)
